name: tlween
description: Edit and paint images with Claude: layers, adjustments, filters, and export (PNG, JPEG, PSD, WebP, TIFF).
long_description: tlween is the image editor of Creative Studio. This extension runs its engine headless so Claude can open, edit and save images in the folder you choose. It reads and writes only inside that folder.

folder.title: Work folder
folder.description: Put your images here. Claude opens images from this folder and saves its work into it.
